name: パレスサイクリング
schedule: Sundays, 10:00 am to 4:00 pm. Off for the summer break (July 19 to Sept 13, 2026), on Oct 18, 2026 (Tokyo Legacy Half Marathon), for the winter break (Dec 27, 2026 to Jan 24, 2027) and on Mar 7, 2027 (Tokyo Marathon). Called off when the Friday 11:00 am JMA forecast gives a 50% or higher chance of rain.
season: year-round, with summer and winter breaks

start_location.name: Palace Cycling course, Iwaidabashi to Hirakawa-mon (Imperial Palace)
start_location.address: 祝田橋～平川門 (Iwaidabashi crossing to Hirakawa-mon), Imperial Palace, Tokyo

duration: Open 10:00 am to 4:00 pm; ride as many laps as you like
pace: Not a race course: the organizers ask riders to keep speeds down and pass only when it is safe

host.name: Japan Bicycle Promotion Institute (自転車産業振興協会)

visitor_notes: No sign-up. Free loaner bikes (about 70, adult city bikes down to kids' bikes) from 10:00 am to 3:30 pm, back by 4:00 pm, one lap per loan; you register on your phone with a QR code at the tent. Since March 2026 you must get off and walk the U-turn at the Hirakawa-mon crossing. Cars come back at 4:00 pm sharp.
description: Every Sunday the road along the Imperial Palace moat closes to cars and opens to bikes: a flat 3 km out-and-back between Iwaidabashi and Hirakawa-mon. It is a family course, not a training loop; kids, tandems and tourists share it and staff ask fast riders to ease off. Free loaner bikes since April 2026 make it an easy first ride in Tokyo.

other: https://jbpi.or.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/2026年度パレスサイクリング事業開催カレンダー.pdf

sources: https://jbpi.or.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/2026年度パレスサイクリング事業開催カレンダー.pdf
evidence: JBPI's Palace Cycling page carries 2026 notices (summer break July 19 to Sept 13, loaner bikes from April 2026) and its FY2026 calendar PDF lists 36 Sunday sessions, including Oct 4, 11 and 25, 2026 (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: Rain calls go up by Friday 11:00 am under 直近のパレスサイクリング開催情報. A new fiscal-year calendar PDF (April to March) is posted each April.

name: Ride This City Tokyo
schedule: Every Saturday, meet 9:30 am at Rapha Tokyo, back about 12:30 pm. Cancelled in rain; the call is made by the evening before.

start_location.name: Rapha Tokyo
start_location.address: 東京都渋谷区神宮前5-29-1, 150-0001 (5-29-1 Jingumae, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo)

visitor_notes: Open ride: no RCC membership needed. Free, but book on Rapha's event site (an Easol account, then name, phone and emergency contact). The listing is in Japanese and English. The clubhouse has bike racks; the café opens at noon.
description: Rapha Tokyo's weekly open Saturday ride from the clubhouse on Cat Street. 30 to 40 km through the city at about 25 km/h, back by 12:30; the route is posted on RideWithGPS. The clubhouse also runs members-only RCC rides (the Arakawa Classic on Sunday mornings, the Yanokuchi Classic on Saturdays at 7:00).
evidence: Rapha's event page for the ride, headed Japan · October 2026, gives Saturday, meet 9:30 am, 30 to 40 km at 25 km/h, open to all (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: events.rapha.cc sits behind a bot check; plain curl gets a 403, a browser fetch works. Rain cancellations are posted the evening before.

name: ワイズロード大阪本館 サンデーライド
schedule: Usually two Sundays a month (July 2026: the 12th and 26th). Meet 8:30 am at the store's front entrance. Dates and routes go up on the store blog each month. Off in August for the heat; resumed Sept 27, 2026.
season: year-round, off in the August heat

start_location.name: Y's Road Osaka Honkan (front entrance)
start_location.address: 大阪府大阪市中央区南久宝寺町2-2-9 船場藤井ビル 1F (2-2-9 Minami-Kyuhojimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka)

pace: Each ride is rated one to five stars; climbs at your own pace, and the leaders wait so nobody ends up riding alone
visitor_notes: Book ahead: register on the Y's Road site, pay the ¥200 fee, then fill in the Google Form for that date. Ten riders max. Helmet and gloves required or you are turned away; bring lights, a bell and a spare tube. Called off if the 5 pm forecast the day before gives over 50% rain for 6 am to noon.
description: The Osaka flagship store's Sunday lunch ride: up to ten riders leave the shop in Senba at 8:30 for about 70 km, often south on the Yamato River cycling road toward Nara or Tondabayashi, with a café lunch at the turn. Each ride carries a star rating so you can pick your level. Staff lead it.
evidence: The store blog announced the Sept 27, 2026 ride (posted Sept 25, 2026) and reported the July 12, 2026 ride as run.

refresh.notes: The feed is WordPress RSS, not ICS: each month's dates arrive as a post titled 【サンデーライド】. Rain calls go on the blog and Instagram the evening before.

name: 朝活サイクリング
name_en: Giant Store Meguro-dori Saturday Morning Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, meet 7:00 am at the store, finish around 9:00 am. No booking. Called off if the chance of rain is over 40%; the call goes on Instagram the evening before.

start_location.name: Giant Store Meguro-dori (ジャイアントストア目黒通り)
start_location.address: 東京都目黒区中根1-4-3 (1-4-3 Nakane, Meguro-ku, Tokyo), one minute from Toritsu-daigaku station on the Tokyu Toyoko line

pace: Set to the riders who show up; the Komazawa Park loop goes at beginner and cross-bike pace
visitor_notes: No booking: just turn up. Any brand of bike is welcome, bought anywhere. Helmet and gloves asked for, and the store asks riders to carry bicycle insurance.
description: A short Saturday-morning shop ride for new and easygoing riders: 20 to 30 km, back by about 9:00. The route is picked on the day from three standards: Tokyo Tower via Shiba Park, easy laps of Komazawa Park, or a photo stop at Giant Japan's head office. Beginners are the point of it.
evidence: The store's post dated Sept 19, 2026 announces the weekly Saturday 7:00 am ride, no booking needed, 20 to 30 km.

refresh.notes: The event page holds the standing schedule; weather cancellations go only on Instagram (@giant_store_meguro) the evening before.

name: Tokyo Night Pedal Cruising (NPC)
schedule: Once a month, usually the third Saturday, in the evening. The June 20, July 18 and Sept 19, 2026 rides met at 5:30 pm at the United Nations University; August's was an all-night Yamanote loop from 10:30 pm. Time and place on each Meetup event.

host.name: Tokyo Night Pedal Cruising NPC (東京ナイトペダルクルージング)

visitor_notes: RSVP on Meetup. Any kind of bike is fine. Most members are Japanese; the group says foreigners are welcome and it is always happy to meet new people.
description: A monthly evening ride through Tokyo at an easy pace, on any kind of bike. Each ride has a theme: a six-park loop, a fireworks ride, an all-night lap of the Yamanote line in August. A good first social ride for a visitor who wants the city at night.
evidence: The group's Meetup page lists rides on June 20, July 18, Aug 15 and Sept 19, 2026, the last from the United Nations University at 5:30 pm (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: The Meetup iCal URL came back empty to curl; the group page embeds each event's date and venue in its page JSON.
